source_rules: Do not treat architecture-fixture content as an academic source.
Do not generate real AP Chemistry curriculum records from general model knowledge during F0.
Follow the College Board CED Unit 1 through Unit 9 structure and its topic order.
Treat PPT U1 through U15 labels as source labels only; do not preserve their numbering as curriculum order.
Use the teacher PowerPoints to set the intended level of student understanding, examples, emphases, and expected reasoning.
Use Zumdahl Chemistry 11e as the chemistry-accuracy and explanatory-truth reference within CED scope.
Use teacher-supplied scoring guides as assessment-demand evidence and do not copy source questions or scoring language verbatim into Story Method content.
Do not silently reconcile conflicts among the CED, teacher materials, textbook, or assessment evidence; record the conflict and apply the relevant authority rule explicitly.
Record the source supporting every required topic before content production.
Keep AP Chemistry status development, student_visible false, and editable false throughout F0.

user_source_directives.organization_and_order: Follow the College Board CED Unit 1 through Unit 9 organization and the topic order within each unit.
user_source_directives.ppt_role: The fifteen PPTs set the intended level of student understanding, examples, classroom emphases, and expected reasoning. PPT numbering is not a course sequence.
user_source_directives.textbook_role: Chemistry information and explanations must be true to Zumdahl, Zumdahl, and DeCoste, Chemistry, 11th edition.
user_source_directives.scope_rule: CED scope controls inclusion. Textbook depth beyond the CED is not automatically added.

scope_guards: 8.11 qualitative pH-solubility only; no solubility-as-function-of-pH calculations

lab_source_directive: Use the CED/public College Board laboratory guidance as the lab-source basis.
